description: Kubernetes manages groups of containers. We will learn Pods, Deployments and Services by reading small configuration files and safe inspection commands. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
learningObjectives: Practise services give a stable route

seo.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Kubernetes with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
